chunks: He who is given his ledger in his right hand, will say: 'Here, read my ledger.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when a person is given their book in the right hand on the Day of Judgment?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, receiving the book in the right hand signifies the culmination of a life aligned with divine will and the Ahl al-Bayt's teachings, contrasting sharply with the left-hand recipients. The phrase 'Haumu iqra'uhu' reflects not just personal triumph but a public declaration of accountability, where the righteous invite the heavens and earth to witness their integrity. This moment underscores the Shia emphasis on the tangible evidence of one's spiritual state in the Hereafter.
